[[Shekoss' Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Shekoss the Stony]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Joko's Domain]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Earth damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Earth Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +60

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Earth Staff (Elonian)]].

**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]

*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]

==Unique counterpart==
*The [[Earth Magic]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Kerrsh's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Moteh's Lightning Spire]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Lightning damage]] and requires [[Air Magic]].
*[[Everlasting Shadow Staff]] and [[Prismatic Staff]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Chaos damage]] and require [[Energy Storage]].
*[[Exuro's Will]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Fire Magic]].
